Modern cluster playground

Real wheel-only SVGs, modern style, light theme.

Chart

Air between clusters

Redrawn by the renderer: every notch is a chart kerykeion actually produced, not a stretched one.

Cluster sizes

Multipliers on the current render (1.00 = as it draws today).

Row spacing

Squeezes or opens the gaps between glyph, degrees, sign, minutes and ℞, holding the glyph still.

Summary

Air is a real render. Sizes and row spacing are rewritten in the browser: faithful about magnitudes, but the row positions a chosen size implies still have to come back out of derive_modern_cluster_profiles.py.
